questions.question: Viewer reads: she sees he made her tea - carried by: IRIS, second white mug, steaming

IRIS: does the face/body read as moved, surprised (restrained)? Must NOT read as: laughter.

IRIS sounds like the voice bible: quiet clear female voice; no reference take yet (the first accepted speaking take becomes it)
Planned size CLOSE, EYE_LEVEL, STATIC: does the take match?

Last frame matches state SC05_end: Continues from the previous shot: IRIS standing across the table, frame-left; HAL seated at the table, frame-right; the key: flat on the table in front of the empty chair; the mugs: two white mugs on the table, the second one steaming beside the key; the empty chair: pulled out from the table on the left.

Is the place where HAL stands kept out of frame (never shown empty), and do IRIS's eyes go just past the lens to frame-right?
Does IRIS look at mug_iris and never into the lens?

instructions: Fill checks[] (result, severity on FAIL, level, evidence, reviewer human:<id>), then `film.py review --film DIR --ingest FILE`. Leave a group UNASSESSED if you did not look.
